points.description: States that the star (*) operator is the dereferencing (indirection) operator.
States that it returns an alias/synonym for the object pointed to (equivalently, an lvalue referring to that object), not merely a copy of the object's value.
points.partial_credit: Award partial credit if the answer says it returns the object or value at the pointed-to address but does not express that the result is an alias/synonym/lvalue for the object.

levels.says: Says it returns the object or value stored at the pointed-to address, without saying it is an alias/synonym/lvalue for that object.

points.description: Indicates that the operand is a pointer (or holds an address) and that the returned object is the one in memory to which that pointer points.

rubric.notes: Full marks require naming the operator as dereferencing/indirection, saying it yields an alias/synonym (lvalue) for the pointed-to object, and identifying the operand as a pointer to an object in memory. Part marks are available on P2 for saying it returns the value/object at the address without the alias/lvalue idea. No marks are earned for merely restating the symbol or describing multiplication.
